name: We & Win Diversification Co., Ltd.
summary: We & Win Diversification Co., Ltd., a company headquartered in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, primarily focuses on the acquisition, rental, and sale of real estate properties across the island. Beyond its core property activities, the firm's operations encompass a diverse range of sectors, including investments in public infrastructure projects, the development of new towns and communities, the wholesale distribution of medical equipment, and various international trade endeavors. Established in 1987, the entity originally traded as Oncoprobe Biotech Inc. before adopting its current designation of We & Win Diversification Co., Ltd. in 2009.
